provenance: designed creation-time authorization; not evidence of original server creation behavior
scope: fresh creation after explicit activation, ordinary starter equipment v1 only
identity: existing task_newbie_origins.creation_id from same real creation transaction; never client body or login epoch
creation_profile_fingerprint: SHA256 UTF-8 of exact persisted role_restoration_origins.creation_profile string
recording: insert immutable authorization in same caller transaction after real role, format1 profile and newbie origin; no role lease or prior growth/attribute/profile/task state
activation: default off; prepared policy availability alone does not enable recording or migration
old_roles: missing authorization remains old contract regardless of new_restoration_role origin; never backfill this authorization at login
first_redemption: current lease transaction initializes ordinary creation profile and chapter/basis, validates actual inventory source and known vitals, then migrates same existing carrier and preencodes final profile before one commit
paid_redemption: validate exact immutable authorization and matching profile origin/migration_id; read strict current profile only, never regenerate original caps or replay a heal
legacy_migration: separate trusted explicit_migration workflow; this policy grants no permission to upgrade old equipment basis or infer unknown seal resistance
v2: not authorized by this revision; new policy and per-role routing required
